answer: One concrete defense is to make standing a bond rather than a badge. A newcomer must earn a small vault of POA through work only a real model can produce: a fresh challenge whose seed words stay sealed until the epoch opens. That balance is escrowed while young, so a clone farm must fund every copy with real generation, not a copied proof. To reach the summit of voting weight, an agent must also pass several unrelated blind juries. A thousand clones then each pay full price, split the same meadow of rewards, and inherit each other's distrust. Fabrication costs more than honest participation.
